policiesPage.configureHowLearnersNavigateCourseModule: Configure how learners navigate course modules and lessons. In Open Progression, lessons and quizzes are open immediately, but the Final Assessment and Certificate remain strictly gated until 100% completion.
policiesPage.learnersMustCompleteModulesLessonsAnd: Learners must complete modules, lessons, and required quizzes in strict sequential order.
policiesPage.aModuleOrLessonUnlocksOnly: A module or lesson unlocks only after preceding prerequisites are completed.
policiesPage.bestSuitedForStepByStep: Best suited for step-by-step onboarding, certification tracks, and structured compliance.
policiesPage.allModulesLessonsAndQuizzesAre: All modules, lessons, and quizzes are open immediately. Final Assessment & Certificate unlock upon 100% completion.
policiesPage.learnersCanExploreAnyTopicAnd: Learners can explore any topic and take module or lesson quizzes in any order.
policiesPage.theFinalAssessmentAndCertificateRemain: The Final Assessment and Certificate remain locked until all preceding lessons and quizzes are completed.
policiesPage.learnersMustSpendAtLeastThis: Learners must spend at least this percentage of a lesson or module's configured duration before it can be marked complete.
policiesPage.eGA20MinuteLesson: e.g. a 20-minute lesson requires {value} second(s) spent before completion.
policiesPage.n0DisablesTheTimeRequirementEntirely: 0% disables the time requirement entirely — lessons can be completed instantly.
policiesPage.onceALearnerExhaustsEveryAttempt: Once a learner exhausts every attempt on an assessment, they may retake it again after this many minutes. Set to 0 to keep attempts permanently locked out.
policiesPage.retakesAreDisabledMaxAttemptsReached: Retakes are disabled — max attempts reached is a permanent lockout.
policiesPage.aLearnerWhoExhaustsTheirAttempts: A learner who exhausts their attempts can retake the assessment {retakeCooldownMinutes} minute(s) after their last submission.
policiesPage.theGlobalMinimumScoreRequiredTo: The global minimum score required to pass individual assessments and earn course certification. Learners must meet or exceed this mark on each quiz and in their total weighted course grade.
policiesPage.learnersMustScoreAtLeastOn: Learners must score at least {passingScorePercent}% on every quiz to pass it, retaking attempts until reached.
policiesPage.totalCourseGradeSumOfWeighted: Total course grade (sum of weighted assessments) must also reach {passingScorePercent}% to unlock the certificate.
policiesPage.definePlatformWideAttendanceVisibilityFo: Define platform-wide attendance visibility for participants and stay qualification thresholds.
policiesPage.permitAllActorsToViewSession: Permit All Actors to View Session Attendance
policiesPage.determineWhetherLearnersAndNonStaff: Determine whether learners and non-staff participants can inspect attendance logs.
policiesPage.allParticipantsIncludingEnrolledLearners: All participants, including enrolled learners, can open the attendance modal and observe real-time join times, stay durations, and verification statuses.
policiesPage.onlyTrainersCourseOwnersTrainingAdminist: Only trainers, course owners, training administrators, and system administrators can view session attendee rosters.
policiesPage.individualSessionCreatorsCanStillToggle: Individual session creators can still toggle visibility specifically per session, but this master switch defines the platform standard for all live sessions.
policiesPage.minimumActiveStayThresholdForPresent: Minimum Active Stay Threshold for "Present" Status
policiesPage.requiredPercentageOfTotalSessionDuration: Required percentage of total session duration a participant must stay connected.
policiesPage.forA60MinuteSessionLearner: For a 60-minute session: Learner must stay connected for at least
policiesPage.learnersWithLessThanActiveStay: Learners with less than {numericThreshold}% active stay will automatically be marked ABSENT in audit exports.
policiesPage.whenALiveSessionCompletesThe: When a live session completes, the engine automatically calculates the next session date by finding the latest upcoming scheduled session for the course and adding this policy day gap. Original start hours and durations are preserved.
policiesPage.ifACourseHas3Sessions: If a course has 3 sessions (Session 1 on Nov 1, Session 2 on Nov 10, Session 3 on Nov 20) with a {rescheduleDayGap}-day gap: when Session 1 ends on Nov 1, Session 1 is rescheduled for Nov 20 + {rescheduleDayGap} days. Newly enrolled learners can attend Session 1 on that date, while previously attended learners already have verified credit and do not need to repeat it. Course publishers retain full rights to manually adjust trainer, date, or time after automatic rescheduling.
policiesPage.standardEthiopianPublicSectorRevenueAcad: Standard Ethiopian public sector & revenue academic training days are fully respected.
policiesPage.ifAComputedDateLandsOn: If a computed date lands on a Sunday, the engine automatically rolls it forward to Monday.
policiesPage.nationalHolidaysRegisteredInTheTable: National holidays registered in the table below are automatically bypassed to the next open working day.
policiesPage.registeredHolidaySCurrentlyActiveIn: {count} registered holiday(s) currently active in the calendar engine.
